incomeIntro.title: Other Income
incomeIntro.subtitle: Besides employment, we need to know about other money your household receives.
incomeIntro.typesHeading: We'll ask about these types of income:
incomeIntro.noOtherIncome: My household has no other income

incomeInfo.title: Other Income Details
incomeInfo.description: Toggle each income type your household receives, then enter the details.

ssi.label: Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
ssi.description: Need-based payments for aged, blind, or disabled

rental.label: Rental Income
rental.description: Income from property you rent out

contrib.label: Contributions from Others
contrib.description: Regular financial help from people outside household

tribal.label: Tribal / Per-capita Payments
tribal.description: Payments from tribal gaming or trust

other.label: Other Income
other.description: Any other income not listed above

incomeInfo.docPromptHeading: You listed {{incomeType}} — upload your most recent award letter.
incomeInfo.noIncomeConfirm: You haven't entered any income. Is that correct?
incomeInfo.snapReviewWarningTitle: This may trigger an expedited SNAP review
incomeInfo.snapReviewWarningBody: Reporting zero income flags your case for expedited processing. If this is a mistake, go back and add your income sources — including Social Security, SSI, child support, or any other payments your household receives.
incomeInfo.commonSourcesTitle: Common sources people forget to include:
incomeInfo.confirmNoIncome: Yes, I Have No Other Income

incomeDiscrepancy.title: Income Mismatch — Please Review
incomeDiscrepancy.description: We found a difference between the income you entered and records we have on file. Please review and let us know how to proceed.
incomeDiscrepancy.infoBanner: Data sourced from federal records (IRS, SSA). This is routine and does not imply any wrongdoing.
incomeDiscrepancy.howToProceed: How would you like to proceed?
incomeDiscrepancy.resolutionMine: My entry is correct — I confirm the amount I entered
incomeDiscrepancy.resolutionExplain: I need to explain the difference

employmentIntro.title: Employment & Income
employmentIntro.subtitle: We need to know about jobs and income for everyone in your household. This helps us determine the right benefits for you.
employmentIntro.householdNote: This section covers all household members, not just the primary applicant. We'll ask about each person separately.

argyle.title: Keep it up to date automatically
argyle.description: Connect your payroll provider via Argyle to keep your income updated each month. No paystubs needed.

employmentIntro.noOneWorks: No one in my household works

jobInfo.title: Current Employment
jobInfo.description: Enter details about current jobs for your household.
jobInfo.selfEmploymentHint: Freelance, gig work, own business, farming, etc.
jobInfo.payTypeTooltip: Gross pay is the amount before taxes and deductions. Net pay is the amount you actually receive (take-home pay). Use gross pay if possible.
jobInfo.avgMonthlyIncomeHint: Since your pay varies, estimate your typical monthly gross income.
jobInfo.hoursPerWeekHint: Used to estimate monthly income and check work requirement compliance.
jobInfo.tipsCommissionsBonuses: I receive tips, commissions, or bonuses
jobInfo.medicaidWarningTitle: This income may exceed Medicaid limits
jobInfo.medicaidWarningBody: Your estimated income of {{estimated}} exceeds the Medicaid limit of {{limit}} for a household of {{householdSize}}. You may still qualify for other programs or marketplace tax credits.
jobInfo.medicaidWarningDisclaimer: This is an estimate only. A caseworker will make the final eligibility determination based on verified income.

jobHistory.previousEmploymentDescription: Tell us about any jobs held in the last 30 days that are no longer active.
jobHistory.grossPayLabel: Gross Pay at Time of Leaving
jobHistory.grossPayHint: Enter gross pay per pay period
jobHistory.workHistoryDescription: We found previous employment from your {{provider}} account. Please review each record.
jobHistory.pleaseConfirm: Please confirm each entry is still correct
jobHistory.allRecordsRemoved: All records have been removed. Tap continue to proceed.
jobHistory.removeRecordMessage: This will remove the following record:
jobHistory.removeRecordHint: If this record is wrong and doesn't belong to you, removing it is the right thing to do. You can still add jobs manually later.

jobSummary.title: Employment Summary
jobSummary.description: Review the jobs entered for your household.
jobSummary.goBackAndAdd: Go back and add a job
jobSummary.docHeadingW2: You listed income of ${{amount}}/month at {{employer}} — upload a recent pay stub to verify.
jobSummary.docHeadingSelfEmployed: You listed self-employment income — upload your most recent tax return or profit/loss statement.

argyleConnect.selectProviderDescription: Choose the payroll system your employer uses so we can securely verify your income.
argyleConnect.credentialsSecurity: Your account is connected securely through Argyle. State-X HHS never sees your login details.
argyleConnect.connectDescription: Argyle will open a secure connection to your {{provider}} account to verify your income. Your credentials go directly to {{provider}} — State-X HHS never sees them.
argyleConnect.encryptionNotice: Argyle uses bank-level 256-bit encryption. Your credentials are never stored by State-X HHS.
argyleConnect.successDescription: Your {{provider}} account is now linked. Argyle will automatically keep your income information up to date each month.
argyleConnect.autoRefreshNotice: Income data will be refreshed automatically. You can disconnect this at any time from your account settings.

workRequirements.title: Medicaid Work Requirements
workRequirements.description: State-X Medicaid requires most adults ages 19–64 to work, volunteer, or participate in approved activities for at least 80 hours per month. We'll ask about your current activities to determine if this applies to you.

activities.approvedPrograms: Approved work programs (e.g., DHS Employment Services)
activities.caregiving: Caregiving for a dependent child under 6 or incapacitated adult

workRequirements.currentlyActiveLabel: Are you currently employed, in school, or participating in any of the activities listed above?
workRequirements.activityDescriptionLabel: Brief description of your current activity
workRequirements.exemptionsLabel: Do any of the following apply to you? (select all that apply)

exemptions.ssdi: Receiving Social Security Disability (SSDI) or SSI
exemptions.medical: Medically certified as unable to work
exemptions.caregiverChild: Primary caregiver of a child under age 6
exemptions.caregiverAdult: Primary caregiver of an incapacitated adult
exemptions.education: Currently enrolled in an approved education or training program

workRequirements.noneWarning: You may need to fulfill work requirements to receive or maintain Medicaid coverage. A caseworker will contact you to discuss your options.
